items.headline: Edgeworth Accountant: An Analytical Approach to Differential Privacy Composition
items.summary:
arXiv:2206.04236v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: In privacy-preserving data analysis, many procedures and algorithms are structured as compositions of multiple private building blocks. As such, an important question is how to efficiently compute the overall privacy loss under composition. items.summary:
arXiv:2604.05955v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Repository-level issue resolution benchmarks have become a standard testbed for evaluating LLM-based agents, yet success is still predominantly measured by test pass rates.
